parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of same-sex conduct (decriminalised 2012), and the documented social climate is mixed rather than hostile: the sole LGBTI organisation operates freely in all districts, police have a good working relationship, and Pride marches proceed with police escorts. No documented police targeting, facility bans, detention rules, or trans-specific campaign exists, and no dated recent anti-trans violence is recorded. Against this: no legal gender recognition or marker-change procedure; a 2017 legal analysis flags possible charges for a non-matching passport (an open question, not a documented enforcement practice); current submissions document LGBT-wide discrimination, rape and assaults (undated, category-broad) with no general equality protection. Thin-data country with no documented relief infrastructure: unresolved documents exposure plus documented societal stigma with thin recourse hold it below the 0.65 tier, but the absence of any traveller-facing restriction or organised targeting keeps it in Reduced Risk, near ~0.60.
